extracted.intended_audience: researchers, research administrators, universities, companies and policymakers involved in or seeking ANR funding
extracted.subtask_description: Institutional statement of the French National Research Agency's missions, funding priorities, selection principles and operational roles (including France 2030/PIA). Describes what the agency funds, how it programmes calls, and the quality/ethical standards it applies to selection and programme management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote project-based research & stimulate innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: The ANR was founded in 2005 to promote French project-based research and to stimulate innovation by promoting the emergence of collaborative multidisciplinary projects and encouraging collaboration between the public and private sectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on project-based, collaborative, multidisciplinary work and public–private cooperation as central objectives of funded activity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support basic and targeted research
rubrics_metrics.description: To fund and promote the development of basic and targeted research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding scope explicitly includes both fundamental (basic) research and targeted/applied research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support technological innovation
rubrics_metrics.description: To fund and promote technological innovation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages projects that drive novel technologies or improvement of existing technologies; innovation is a stated mission-level priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Encourage technology transfer
rubrics_metrics.description: To fund and promote technology transfer.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that facilitate the movement of research results into practical application, industry or public use are within ANR remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Promote public–private partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: To fund and promote public-private partnerships.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ANR explicitly encourages collaboration between public operators (e.g., universities, research organisations) and private companies as part of its mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement the Minister-approved Work Programme
rubrics_metrics.description: To implement the Work Programme approved by the French Minister of Research, following consultation with the supervisory ministers of France’s research bodies and public higher education institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ANR executes the Work Programme as defined by the ministry after stakeholder consultation; calls and actions flow from that Programme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage major government investment programmes (PIA/France 2030)
rubrics_metrics.description: To manage major government investment programmes in the fields of higher education and research and to oversee their implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ANR acts as implementing/management body for large national investment initiatives (PIA, France 2030), including oversight responsibilities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Strengthen European and international scientific cooperation
rubrics_metrics.description: To strengthen scientific cooperation across Europe and worldwide by aligning its Work Programme with European and international initiatives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority for projects/partners that foster European/international collaboration and alignment with broader initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyse research trends and assess funding impact
rubrics_metrics.description: To analyse trends in research offering and assess the impact of the funding it allocates on scientific output in France.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: ANR monitors the research landscape and evaluates how its funding affects national scientific outputs; impact assessment is part of mission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support excellence across TRLs
rubrics_metrics.description: Activities are designed to support the excellence of French research at a variety of technological readiness levels (TRL), support basic research, encourage academic and public-private scientific partnerships and promote European and international cooperation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit support for projects across different TRLs — from basic research to later-stage technological development — and for partnerships that improve excellence and cooperation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Organise competitive calls and rigorous selection via peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: To organise competitive calls for proposals and conduct rigorous selection processes based on peer review, in compliance with international standards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Selection processes are competitive and peer-reviewed; the agency states compliance with international standards including impartiality, equal treatment, confidentiality, ethics, scientific integrity and transparency. These are the procedural quality criteria applied to evaluating proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Apply principles: impartiality, equal treatment, confidentiality, ethics, scientific integrity, transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection processes are conducted in compliance with international standards: impartiality, equal treatment, confidentiality, ethics, scientific integrity and transparency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These enumerated principles govern peer review and selection — they function as evaluative/operational constraints on how funding decisions are made, and on acceptable conduct for applicants and reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Operate national programmes: selection, agreements, funding, monitoring, auditing and impact review
rubrics_metrics.description: As national operator of France 2030 and previously the PIA, the ANR organises the selection, negotiates agreements, provides funding and performs monitoring, auditing and reviewing the impact of projects and programme activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The agency’s role includes end-to-end programme management — not only selecting projects, but negotiating contractual agreements, disbursing funds, monitoring execution, auditing and assessing outcomes/impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: State-ANR agreements define financing framework and operational modalities
rubrics_metrics.description: An agreement between the State and the ANR sets out for each action the framework for its financing and the operational modalities for its implementation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific financing rules and operational procedures for programmes are codified in formal agreements with the State; applicants and managers are therefore constrained by those frameworks.

rubrics_metrics.name: Programming via stakeholder consultation and Programming Advisory Panels
rubrics_metrics.description: The ANR's programming is decided by the French Research Ministry and developed on the basis of priorities defined in the National Research Strategy, with Programming Advisory Panels constituting the consultation bodies that draft the Work Programme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work Programme content is shaped through consultation with research stakeholders via advisory panels; the Programme offers the scientific community an overview of ANR funding provision and priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality policy and ISO 9001 certification for selection procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: As part of its quality policy, the ANR is strengthening the reliability of its procedures and continuously adapting them to guarantee selection quality, optimise the quality of the service delivered to its community of users and ensure the organisation’s activities efficiency. The Agency has ISO 9001 certification for its selection processes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Continuous improvement and formal quality management (ISO 9001) apply to selection processes — indicating documented, auditable procedures and a commitment to service quality and process reliability.
